Competitor Analysis Top OHS Consulting Companies in South Africa The occupational health and safety consulting sector in South Africa is currently navigating a period of significant transformation, driven by evolving regulatory frameworks, technological advancements, and shifting corporate strategies. As of July 2026, a comprehensive evaluation of the leading occupational health and safety consulting companies in South Africa requires an understanding of both the localized industry dynamics and the broader global context. The global occupational health market is projected to experience substantial growth, expanding from USD 5.82 billion in 2026 to USD 9.16 billion by 2033 [1] . While this overarching global expansion underscores the increasing economic value placed on workplace safety, the South African market exhibits its own unique characteristics, key players, and competitive drivers. To systematically evaluate this landscape, a comparative framework for the top occupational health and safety consulting companies in South Africa has been established. When examining the market positioning and key players within the South African context, the available market intelligence reveals a fragmented landscape where a few prominent entities lead the discourse.
